Contribution accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics

The article "State of the ‘Art’: A Taxonomy of Artistic Stylization Techniques for Images and Video" by Jan Eric Kyprianidis, John Collomosse, Tinghuai Wang, and Tobias Isenberg has been accepted for publication in a future issue of IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics.
